name: 32256 · Jacksonville, FL
findings: ZIP 32256 (Jacksonville) has 237 nonprofit organizations. 92 of them (39%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 77 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (21% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 32256 (Jacksonville) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
